items.title: Sustainability leadership moves
items.summary: As corporate sustainability matures, some long-time leaders are leaving the profession, while others are tackling a broader set of responsibilities following reorganizations or layoffs.

items.title: How Royal Mail will use AI to calculate supplier emissions
items.summary: The sustainability team at Royal Mail, Britain’s primary postal service, is testing a tool that uses artificial intelligence to estimate the potential carbon emissions that might be generated by new vendor contracts.

items.title: 45-minute Masterclass: What SMEs need to know before investing in solar
items.summary: Event Date: 05/11/2026 | 1:00 pm UK | 8:00 am US East Coast ET | 5:00 am US West Coast PT | 2:00 pm Central Europe CET/CEST This webinar, delivered in partnership with British Gas, will explore how SMEs can overcome the key investment and deployment challenges surrounding onsite solar power, and maximise the returns on investment.

items.title: MPs warn inconsistent Government messaging could undermine energy transition
items.summary: MPs have urged the UK Government to change how it communicates the energy transition, with current messaging described as inconsistent, overly technical and too heavily focused on the “net-zero” target.

items.title: Growing through M&A without losing sight of sustainability
items.summary: Acquisitions can complicate sustainability targets and data, but they also offer opportunities to strengthen environmental programmes and build more resilient businesses, says Tate & Lyle chief executive Nick Hampton.

items.title: Report: Businesses increase climate adaptation spending as net-zero progress slows
items.summary: Executives increasingly view climate adaptation not as a secondary concern, but as essential to business survival.

items.title: NEXT WEEK: Practical actions to drive circularity across the business value chain
items.summary: In a week's time, edie will hold its new webinar exploring how organisations can turn circular economy commitments into practical, measurable action across the business value chain.

items.title: Technology briefing: Will second-life EV batteries unlock on-site energy optimisation?
items.summary: Millions of EV batteries will reach the end of their useful life in the coming decades. Innovators are putting them to new uses, yet challenges remain.
